description: Use this when the person wants the full detail of one service they have found with find_care, find_blood_tests or find_scans. Pass its key, and the city outside London. Returns what is included, the fee as the checkout or the city page shows it, the length, the doctors with their register links, the regulator, the hours and how to book or request it.

city.description: Where the person wants to be seen, e.g. London, Dubai, Riyadh. Default London.

service.description: The service key, e.g. "gp-same-day", "core" or a city key such as "executive-health".

name: get_service
title: Get one service in full
